name: 女童套头针织浮凸圆领短袖衫款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清正面版型、滚边圆领与胸前浮凸图位，承担点击。
一秒把这套针织衫的第一购买理由讲完，承担主图一秒法则的首屏主张。
shots.textZone: upper-left beveled-corner card in iris violet #7A5AA6 carries 「{selling_point_1}」 with one narrow small-cap kicker rail above it

shots.intent: 把领口滚边与肩线是否稳住这一具体顾虑放大成同框两态，制造对照动机。
用纯影棚纸场与阶梯纸台给出可代入的穿着比例，替代实景街拍。
用织面与浮凸层次的真实立体感承担品质证明，不写任何成分与检测口径。
同一件下摆两种处理同框等比对照，用可验证的穿着差异代替任何效果断言。
把滚领、袖口与肩缝三处做工在同一横带里等比摊开，替掉口头品质断言。
shots.textZone: lower band of each panel carries one blank beveled label slot with 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用空白尺码梯与空指示条承接规格疑虑，把全部实测数值留给卖家自填。
让买家在一屏内比完可选配色与正反面，色名一律留空由卖家自填。
shots.textZone: three blank swatch outlines under the columns carry 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 以一镜收口把成套记忆点与行动位叠在一起，优惠与行动文案全部留空。
shots.textZone: right 35%: beveled card 「{selling_point_2}」 above one empty button slot carrying 「{callout_6}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pearl-white paper sweep #F7F6FA for packshot, flat-lay and card fields; one lilac-grey paper wall-and-floor stage #E1D9EC carrying a single hard-edged diagonal shadow band as the only recurring worn field; deep aubergine matte panel #2B2536 reserved for construction macro; iris violet #7A5AA6 only ever as one beveled headline card, one hairline rule or one empty outline, never a full field; no outdoor ground, no furnished interior, no mirror, no arch, no second wall colour
style.direction: lilac-paper girls knitwear commerce, hard-edged gobo-shadow discipline with beveled-corner paper cards and quiet infographic restraint
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons drawn inside beveled-corner square cells, top-right and bottom-left corners cut at 45 degrees, outlined in deep aubergine #2B2536 with every cell centre left blank, plus one iris-violet hairline X cross used only as a section divider; no circular icon plates, no hexagon or diamond cells, no solid square index chips, no corner-triangle flags, no round magnifier windows, no circular photo masks, no scalloped or taped cards, no seal or badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light from the upper left at about 6500K, one hard-edged diagonal gobo shadow band on the paper wall, gentle fill on the shadow side, thin soft contact shadow under every laid edge, no harsh speculars and no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent lilac-paper girls knitwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl-white paper sweep #F7F6FA, lilac-grey paper stage #E1D9EC, deep aubergine ink #2B2536 and one iris violet accent #7A5AA6; cool soft studio light from the upper left at about 6500K with one hard-edged diagonal gobo shadow band, gentle fill and thin soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one narrow wide-tracked small-cap kicker rail; thin single-weight line icons inside beveled-corner square cells with blank centres and one hairline X cross section divider; clean high-end children's knitwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 worn attitude and stable laid-flat scale; generic child model always cropped from the neck down; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible lettering or numerals inside any graphic zone.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the single iris violet #7A5AA6
no mixed fonts, no brush lettering, no script and no oversized wall word

style.presentationRules: one consistent slight 3/4 worn attitude and one consistent laid-flat scale across the set; every worn frame is a generic child model cropped from the neck down; macro crops stay square to the fabric face; the chest relief zone is never redrawn or read out; nothing clipped except a deliberate hem crop
style.surfaceSystem: matte pearl-white paper sweep #F7F6FA used both as backdrop and as the card stock of every inset; matte lilac paper floor #E1D9EC with two low stepped paper risers in the same tone; one pale dot-grid coordinate board #EDE7F5 used only under the measurement screen; deep aubergine board #2B2536 under macro crops; knit faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one narrow wide-tracked small-cap kicker rail used only above a headline; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-46pt, subline 14-18pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no brush lettering, no serif, no handwriting, no script, no outline lettering and no oversized wall word
